pages.title: When the alarm sounds
pages.text: A city on alert can send reinforcements and activate its forcefield generators. An Alarm panel shows Safe, Alert or Dead.$(br2)Further sightings keep the alert alive. Breaking contact and retreating gives it time to settle. A quiet floating complex may have no active outer shield until an alert begins.

pages.title: Crossing a shield
pages.text: Active shield panels damage intruders and intercept projectiles. A matching city forcefield-immunity card in your inventory protects you from that shield’s contact damage.$(br2)Door and storage cards grant different permissions. Do not test a shield by walking into it with an unverified card.$(br2)Damaged panels may leave temporary openings.
